author_decision.notes: The author approved direct use of the analysis-note PDF in thesis Sec. 3.3.5. The portable redraw has not replaced that adopted artifact.

historical.publication_or_note_figure: Analysis-note and PRC-supplement per-crystal spectra before and after reconstruction

binning: Individual spectra: 1000 bins over 0--100 MeV, displayed after factor-ten rebinning
Reconstructed spectra: 1000 bins over 0--200 MeV, displayed after factor-five rebinning
display_policy: Historical 4 x 4 detector-layout panel order with one empty panel
Blue individual spectra and red reconstructed spectra
physics_contract.fit_or_transform: No fit or spectrum transformation is performed at the figure layer; M8 produces the per-run histograms and M9 adds them over the explicit figure sample.
inputs: The exact 59 March 5--10 run groups in reconstruction_spectra_figure_run_groups.tsv
M8 per-run ROOT outputs containing the historical per-crystal histogram families
physics_contract.sample: The historical figure sample contains 59 beam-on run groups from March 5 through March 10. It is distinct from the reviewed 60-group central analysis sample, which additionally contains one March 4 run group.
selections: All 15 h_eDep spectra require a valid corrected time in the historical producer
Corner and excluded crystals retain only the individual detector spectrum
variables: Reconstructed cluster energy assigned to the corresponding core crystal

portable.command: Run M9 with analysis/data_preprocessing/config/reconstruction_spectra_figure_run_groups.tsv as the beam-on manifest, then run python3 plotting/plot_reconstruction_spectra.py --per-crystal-root /path/to/beam-on/all_notree.root --output-dir results/figures/reconstruction_spectra.

public_boundary.notes: Experimental data, M8/M9 ROOT outputs, and generated binary figures are not distributed.

title: Per-crystal spectra before and after shower reconstruction

validation.notes: The adopted PDF is the unchanged historical analysis-note artifact and its source/adopted checksums agree. The new portable M8/M9 plus Python path has passed static and manifest checks but has not been rerun on the full 59-group experimental sample.
